# Riverbend Nonprofit Network theory of change: headline metrics

As of 2026-09-30.

## Who is told what

| Indicator | Network board | Members | Funders |
|-----------|---|---|---|
| Attendee hours across all three program areas | 1 |  | 1 |
| Leadership practice maturity | 2 | 1 | 2 |
| Stories of members helping each other |  | 2 | 3 |

A number is the place the indicator takes in that audience's list.

## Network board

No headline list is chosen for this audience, so these are the indicators reported to it, in file order.

| Number | Latest | Status | How to describe it |
|--------|--------|--------|--------------------|
| Attendee hours across all three program areas | 4880 hours (on 2026-09-30) | On track | attributable to the work |
| Leadership practice maturity | Emerging (on 2026-09-30) | On track | a contribution, not attributable to the work alone |

Notes on these numbers:

- Attendee hours across all three program areas: Equals 3650 + 760 + 470.
- Leadership practice maturity: The first cohort has not yet reached its twelve-month rating.

Caveats that go with these numbers:

- Rated by coaches and members, so it reflects self-assessment as well as observed practice.
